assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia.
To capture the elusive nature of these symptoms and correlate them with cardiac rhythm disturbances, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated.
CPT 93247 is indicated for long-term continuous ECG monitoring.
The claim was submitted for episode ep-03050.
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204.
